findings.issue_text: [BUG] app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb:17 — `request.referer` is interpolated into a JavaScript string literal with no escaping; an apostrophe/quote/backslash in the referer produces a JS syntax error that kills the inline script, so the iframe never reports its height (auto-resize silently broken for those pages).

[BUG] app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:33 — `i.content` is unconditionally called on each feed item, but `content` is an Atom element; for RSS 2.0 feeds it is nil and `nil.scrub` raises NoMethodError with no per-item rescue, aborting the entire poll. With `retry: false` an RSS 2.0 feed gets zero imports and fails every run.

[ADVISORY] Gemfile:209-211 — new gems `ruby-readability` and `simple-rss` are added but only `Gemfile_rails4.lock` is updated; `Gemfile.lock` is missing the new entries, so CI/deploys installing from the default lockfile fail with a Bundler error or silently diverge.

[ADVISORY] app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:4-6 — `discourseUrl` and `discourseEmbedUrl` are dereferenced as undeclared globals with nothing in the repo defining or documenting them, so integrators get `ReferenceError: discourseUrl is not defined` and an empty embed; a usage example defining both globals is needed.

[ADVISORY] lib/tasks/disqus.thor:117 — the `--category/-c` option is removed from the `import` thor command and `TopicEmbed.import_remote` never accepts a category — a silent breaking change to a public CLI surface with no deprecation; existing `disqus.thor import -c` scripts break with 'Unknown switches' or dump threads into uncategorized.

[ADVISORY] app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:21-23 — `feed_key` and its `@feed_key` memoization are defined but never called; the computed feed-modified key is never read or written, so the conditional-fetch/etag logic it implies is absent (dead, misleading code).

[ADVISORY] app/models/topic_embed.rb:47-49 — `TopicEmbed.import` mutates the caller's `contents` string in place by appending the footer before hashing, so `content_sha1` is computed over appended content and callers reusing the string see corrupted data (e.g., a second footer accumulating on the RSS path); a non-mutating local copy should be used.

[BUG] Stored XSS via unsanitized RSS content: PollFeed passes i.content raw into TopicEmbed.import with cook_method: raw_html, bypassing Sanitize, and best.html.erb renders it with raw post.cooked, allowing script/iframe/onerror payloads from a hostile feed to execute in every visitor's browser on /embed/best

[ADVISORY] after_post_cook plugin filter is silently skipped for raw_html posts in Post#cook (app/models/post.rb:131), so plugins that rewrite cooked HTML (oneboxes, image resizing, link stripping) do nothing for imported posts with no compat gate or documentation
[ADVISORY] feed_key is dead code: the declared 'feed modified' check is never implemented, so poll_feed re-parses and re-processes the entire feed every hour with no failure handling and retry: false

[ADVISORY] Origin check discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1 in embed.js is a substring match that any origin sharing discourseUrl's text passes, and fails open for empty-string origins; should be strict equality
